ID you'll needPrimary, secondary and referee options+

Two primary IDs, or one primary and one secondary

  • Passport
  • National Identity Card (NID)
  • Driver's licence
  • Birth certificate (under 18s)
  • Super fund ID and statement

Secondary IDs

  • Employment ID with an employment confirmation letter
  • Marriage certificate
  • School certificate
  • Valid student ID with a school confirmation letter
  • Statutory declaration with a passport photo

No standard ID? Two approved referees

  • Lawyer or legal practitioner
  • Pastor or minister of religion
  • District Court magistrate
  • Bank manager or assistant manager
  • CPA PNG accountant
  • Ward or LLG councillor
  • PNGDF commissioned officer
  • Head of a school or tertiary institution
  • Registered medical practitioner
  • Provincial police commander
  • Commissioner of Oaths
  • Permanent NBCL employee
Each referee completes a statutory declaration stamped by a practising lawyer or Commissioner of Oaths. Referee letters are accepted for Fairer Access, and for Simpler and Smarter Access when standard ID is not available.

How to open

Open an account in three steps.

1

Choose your account

Compare the accounts above, or ask our team which suits you best.

2

Bring your documents

A completed New Account Application Form, two current forms of ID (such as National ID, passport or driver's licence) and your opening deposit.

3

Visit a branch

Open your account at any of our 11 branches. We'll set up your card and digital banking on the spot.

Don't have all the ID you need? You may still be able to open a Fairer Access Account with restricted limits.

Questions

Account FAQs

Can I open an account online?+

Not at this time. Visit your nearest NBCL branch with a completed New Account & Card Application Form, your opening deposit and two primary forms of ID.

What is a Fairer Access Account?+

It's designed for customers who may not meet standard identification requirements. It gives you everyday banking with restricted conditions: it can't hold more than K1,000 at one time, with an annual turnover limit of K10,000 until full ID is provided.

Can I open a joint account?+

Yes. Savings accounts can be opened jointly by family members, spouses or business partners.

Do you charge dormant account fees?+

An account is considered dormant after 12 months of inactivity. There is no dormant fee on Fairer Access or Smarter Access. Simpler Access accounts are charged K4.

Should I choose pay-as-you-go or a flat monthly fee?+

If you want flexibility and only want to pay for what you use, choose Simpler Access. If you bank often and want one predictable monthly cost, Smarter Access is the better fit.

Can I use digital banking with every account?+

Yes. All NBCL everyday accounts can be used 24/7 on the Mobile App, Online Banking and ATMs across PNG.

Who can be a referee?+

Community leaders and recognised professionals, such as pastors, ward councillors, school principals, District Court magistrates, CPA accountants, doctors and permanent NBCL employees.

Ready to start banking with NBCL?

Apply online, or visit any branch. Bring your ID and opening deposit, and our account specialists will be ready to guide you.
